Class VarNode

java.lang.Object
threepl.nodes.Node
threepl.nodes.VarNode
All Implemented Interfaces:
Constant, ParserConstants
public final class VarNode extends Node implements Constant, ParserConstants
This Node class represents a variable occurrence, possibly with subscripts and fields and a pointer token '->'.

Note that for this Node the first subnode is itself a NodeList of subscript and field nodes. There is a second subnode if this variable node is a pointer reference, the second subnode being a NodeList of the subscript and field nodes to the right of the '->'.

This class is also used for some inbuilt declaration procedure arguments which look like identifiers in parsing but are treated as strings. For example variable modes are passed as "queue" etc having been parsed as variable identifiers and placed in a VarNode class.

    • execute

      public Constant.EXECR execute(TDEVar esig, ArrayList<TDEVar> startl, ArrayList<TDEVar> finishl, QueueRefs queues, boolean toplevel, boolean availok, QueueRefs checkedqueues, TDEVar pri_in, TDEVar pri_out)
      Execute a variable appearing as a statement - usually ++v, v++, --v or v--.
      Overrides:
      execute in class Node
      Parameters:
      esig - is an exception/restart signal, or null
      startl - is a list of start signals for target statements below this node
      finishl - is a list of finish signals for target statements below this node
      queues - returns all the queue availability signals accumulated from code below
      toplevel - is true if this is the top level in a module
      availok - is true if a previous sync makes a queue availability wait unnecessary
      checkedqueues - gives queue reads which have already been checked
      pri_in - is an optional input signal to a priority encoder
      pri_out - is an optional output signal from a priority encoder
      Returns:
      EXECR execution status value
